name: Emerald Lake Club (HutorSki)
listingFacts:
Existing public website content, inspected 2026-11-04; not independently reverified against the original listing. A house for shared meals and weekends together in Dorset, Vermont. Gather around the table, head out for a walk, and leave time for the conversations that happen when nobody needs to rush home. Available for group stays April through November.

Arrival
- Check-in after 3 PM
- Check-out before 11 AM
- Self check-in with smart lock
- Keep the upper driveway to the barn clear
- Many cars: park at the far end of the lot on the grass

Guests and dogs
- Overnight count matches the reservation, including children, dogs and campers
- Two dogs maximum, well behaved and trained, counted in the guest number
- No unapproved guests
- Groups under 25 or with pets: request booking approval

During your stay
- No smoking inside, including vaping and cannabis
- Quiet hours 12 AM – 7 AM
- No loud music outside after 10 PM
- No bonfires; small campfires are fine
- No glass in the basement or on the meadow
- No rain tents or shade structures on the lawn without permission
- Do not move furniture or appliances or rewire A/V and wifi
- Sleep on beds with linens only; blanket washing fee $50
- Clean the grill or oven after use, or a $100 cleaning fee applies
- Septic: flush toilet paper only
- Extra cleaning after a party beyond 4 hours: $50 per hour for 2 cleaners

Before you leave
- Close all windows
- Clean and cover the grill; clean the oven if used
- Remove glasses and dishes from the rooms
- Start the dishwasher
- Lock the door
